title: Editor's Note: Welcome to Barrog
excerpt: A short update from the editor on what Barrog is building and what readers can expect next.
author: ella
body: Welcome to the Barrog blog. This is where the editorial team will share publication updates, notes from contributors, behind-the-scenes context, and calls for future work.
The main magazine issues will still live as designed editions, but this space gives us somewhere lighter and faster to speak to readers between releases.

For now, these posts live in the website code as structured content. Later, the same title, excerpt, body, author photo, and date fields can be powered by a CMS without changing how readers experience the page.
